[P1] 儿童法治教育绘本 财产规则
我的宝石果
律豆博士 著
北京师范大学出版集团
北京师范大学出版社

[P2] 从前，有一座正义岛。正义岛上生活着一群马特人。

杰力马特
勇敢无畏，力气大，但有点儿毛躁。

菠萝马特
胖乎乎的小女生，温和宽厚，喜欢搞发明。

仙子马特
善良、爱美、柔弱，喜欢待在高空的感觉。

大嘴马特
乐于助人、宽容大度、热爱探险。

包子马特
小遇马特
小毛球
洋洋马特

司考马特

眼镜马特
机智、真诚、爱思考，面对困难不退缩。

华尔马特
聪明能干，爱占小便宜，是个机灵鬼。

丹莉马特
聪明好学，爱读书，有点儿小骄傲。

逗逗马特
葱聪马特

[P3] 马特人每天要采很多宝石果。
可是宝石果树长得东一棵，西一棵，
从一棵树到另一棵树得走不少路。

[P4] 他们喜欢把采下来的宝石果堆在树下，回家时再顺路带走。

[P5] 可是有一天，仙子马特采完果子回家时，发现她放在树下的宝石果不见了！

[P6] 仙子马特伤心地往回走，突然，她
看见路边树下有一堆宝石果，咦？
这是我的吗？
应该是
别人的吧。
别人拿了我的，我
为什么不能拿
别人的呢？

[P7] 大嘴马特回来时，吃惊地发现他的果子不见了！

[P8] 大嘴马特沮丧地往回走，突然，他看见路边树下，有一堆宝石果。
这是我的吗？
应该是别人的吧。
别人拿了我的，我为什么不能拿别人的呢？

[P9] 杰力马特回来时，吃惊地发现他的果子不见了！

[P10] 杰力马特愤怒地往回走，突然，他看见路边的一棵宝石果树下，有一堆宝石果。
这是我的吗？
应该是
别人的吧。
别人拿了我的，我
为什么不能拿
别人的呢？

[P11] 最终，杰力马特也拿走了果子。

[P12] 正义岛上一片混乱！
有的马特人专门去拿别人的宝石果，这可比辛辛苦苦自己爬树
去摘省事儿多了！

[P13] 有的马特人只好一直背着所有的宝石果，真累！
还有的马特人不得不一趟一趟把宝石果运回家，真烦！

[P14] 一天，杰力马特远远地看见有人在拿他的宝石果。

[P15] 他追上前去，奋力一扑，抓住了！
原来是华尔马特！

[P16] 杰力马特把华尔马特扭送到大家面前。

[P17] 可是华尔马特却理直气壮地说：“大家都在拿！你们谁没有拿过别人的！”

[P18] 他们只好召开马特人大会。
仙子马特说：“我的果子不见了，看见一堆果子，
觉得也可能就是我的，所以就拿了。”
大嘴马特说：“我也不知道是谁的，就拿了。”
杰力马特说：“别人拿了我的，我为什么不能拿别人的？”
丹莉马特说：“我要再不拿，觉得自己挨饿！”
菠萝马特大声说：“我真不想再这样下去啦！我太累了啦！”
仙子马特说：“我也不想再这样了。”
大嘴马特说：“我们以后都不要乱拿别人的东西了吧！”
华尔马特说：“大家都不拿，我也就不拿了。”
杰力马特说：“可是怎么知道果子是谁的呢？”
丹莉马特说：“把名字写在宝石果上！”

[P19] 最后他们通过了新的规则：
不能拿别人的宝石果。
拿一个赔十个。

[P20] 一天，华尔马特不小心绊了一跤，宝石果被摔了个稀巴烂，他真是心疼极了。

[P21] 呦！前面有两个亮晶晶的宝石果！

[P22] 这次，他又被抓住了！

[P23] 华尔马特抵赖说：“这本来就是我的！”
可大家发现，宝石果上分明写着“大嘴”两个字。

[P24] 华尔马特只好按照规则赔了大嘴马特二十个宝石果。
他心里非常后悔。

[P25] 从此，再也没有人乱拿别人的宝石果了。

[P26] 马特人终于可以放心地走更远的路，

[P27] 去采更多的宝石果了。

full_text_en:
[P1] Children's Legal Education Picture Book Property Rules
My Gem Fruit
By Dr. Lvdou
Beijing Normal University Publishing Group
Beijing Normal University Press

[P2] Once upon a time, there was a Justice Island. On Justice Island lived a group of Martians.

Jieli Martian
Brave and fearless, strong, but a bit clumsy.

Pineapple Martian
A plump little girl, gentle and kind-hearted, who loves inventing.

Fairy Martian
Kind, loves beauty, gentle, enjoys being high up in the air.

Big-Mouth Martian
Helpful, tolerant, loves adventure.

Baozi Martian
Little Yu Martian
Little Ball
Yangyang Martian

Sikao Martian

Glasses Martian
Intelligent, sincere, loves thinking, never gives up in the face of difficulties.

Hualu Martian
Clever and capable, likes to take small advantages, a clever little rascal.

Danli Martian
Smart and studious, loves reading, a bit proud.

Doudou Martian
Congcong Martian

[P3] The Martians have to pick many gem fruits every day.
But the gem fruit trees grow scattered, one here, one there,
so it takes quite a walk to get from one tree to another.

[P4] They like to pile the gem fruits they've picked under the trees, and take them home on their way back.

[P5] But one day, when Fairy Matte finished picking fruits and was going home, she found that the gem fruits she had left under the tree were gone!

[P6] The fairy Matt was walking back sadly, when suddenly, she
saw a pile of gem fruits under a tree by the roadside. Huh?
Is this mine?
It should be
someone else's.
If someone took mine, why
shouldn't I take
someone else's?

[P7] When Big-Mouth Matt returned, he was shocked to find his fruits were gone!

[P8] Daku Maite walked back sadly, and suddenly, he saw a pile of gem fruits under a tree by the roadside.
Is this mine?
It should belong to someone else.
If others took mine, why can't I take others'?

[P9] When Jeli Matte returned, he was shocked to find his fruits were gone!

[P10] Jeli Matte angrily walked back, when suddenly he saw a pile of gem fruits under a gem fruit tree by the roadside.
Are these mine?
They should be
someone else's.
If someone took mine, why can't I take
someone else's?

[P11] In the end, Jeli Matte also took the fruits.

[P12] Justice Island was in chaos!
Some Matts专门 went to take others' gem fruits—it was much easier than climbing trees and picking them themselves!

[P13] Some Mat people had to carry all the gem fruits on their backs all the time—how tiring!
Others had to make trip after trip to carry the gem fruits home—how annoying!

[P14] One day, Jie Li Matte saw from afar someone taking his gem fruits.

[P15] He chased after him, lunged forward with all his might, and caught him!
It was Wal-Mart!

[P16] Jieli Mat dragged Walmart in front of everyone.

[P17] But Walmart said confidently, "Everyone is taking them! Who here hasn't taken someone else's?"

[P18] They had to hold a gathering of the Mat people.
Xianzi Mat said: "My fruit is gone. I saw a pile of fruit, and thought it might be mine, so I took it."
Dakou Mat said: "I didn't know whose it was, so I took it."
Jieli Mat said: "If others took mine, why can't I take others'?"
Danli Mat said: "If I don't take any more, I'll feel hungry!"
Bolo Mat shouted: "I really don't want to go on like this! I'm too tired!"
Xianzi Mat said: "I don't want to go on like this either."
Dakou Mat said: "Let's not take others' things anymore!"
Walmart said: "If nobody takes, then I won't take either."
Jieli Mat said: "But how do we know whose fruit it is?"
Danli Mat said: "Write your name on the gem fruit!"

[P19] In the end, they passed a new rule:
You cannot take someone else's gem fruit.
Take one, pay ten.

[P20] One day, Walmart tripped accidentally, and the gem fruits were smashed to pieces. He was heartbroken.

[P21] Oh! There are two shiny gem fruits ahead!

[P22] This time, he was caught again!

[P23] Walmart insisted, "This was mine all along!"
But everyone noticed that the gem fruit clearly had the words "Big Mouth" written on it.

[P24] Walmart had to pay twenty gem fruits to Big Mouth Mat according to the rules.
He felt very regretful inside.

[P25] From then on, no one ever took someone else's gem fruit again.

[P26] The Martians could finally walk farther with peace of mind,

[P27] Off to gather more gem fruits.

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《我的宝石果》的封面，展示了书名、作者、出版社及插图，画面中有一只粉色小生物提着篮子在森林中行走，另一只灰色小生物躲在灌木丛后。
[P2] 本页介绍了正义岛上生活的马特人族群，并通过图文并茂的方式展示了十一位主要角色及其性格特点。
[P3] 本页描述了马特人每天需要采集宝石果，但由于宝石果树分布零散，他们需要走很远的路才能从一棵树走到另一棵树。
[P4] 本页描绘了马特人将采下的宝石果暂时堆放在树下，准备回家时顺路带走的场景，画面中一只小生物提着篮子走在林间小路上，树下放着两个宝石果。
[P5] 仙子马特采完果子回家，发现她放在树下的宝石果不见了，画面中她站在林间小路上，表情惊讶。
[P6] 仙子马特在回家路上发现树下有一堆宝石果，内心产生疑惑，思考这些果子是否属于自己，以及自己是否有权拿取别人的果子。
[P7] 大嘴马特采完果子回家，发现他放在树下的果子不见了，表情惊讶。
[P8] 大嘴马特在回家路上发现树下有一堆宝石果，内心产生疑惑，思考这些果子是否属于自己，以及自己是否有权拿取别人的果子。
[P9] 杰力马特采完果子回家，发现他放在树下的果子不见了，表情惊讶。
[P10] 杰力马特在回家路上发现树下有一堆宝石果，内心产生疑惑，思考这些果子是否属于自己，以及自己是否有权拿取别人的果子。
[P11] 杰力马特最终也拿走了树下的果子，画面中他提着装满果子的篮子走在林间小路上。
[P12] 正义岛上，一些马特人开始偷拿别人摘下的宝石果，认为这样比自己爬树采摘更省事，导致岛上秩序混乱。
[P13] 画面展示了正义岛上马特人们因偷摘宝石果而产生的困扰：有的背着所有果子很累，有的需要多次往返运送很烦，反映了偷窃行为带来的不便与混乱。
[P14] 杰力马特远远看见有人在拿他放在树下的宝石果，表情惊讶。
[P15] 杰力马特追上偷果子的人并将其抓住，发现偷果子的是华尔马特。
[P16] 杰力马特将偷取他果子的华尔马特扭送到众人面前，周围其他马特人围观，场面紧张。
[P17] 华尔马特被杰力马特抓住偷果子后，面对众人，理直气壮地辩解，声称大家都在偷拿果子，以此为自己开脱。
[P18] 马特人们召开大会，讨论偷拿果子的问题。大家各自表达了自己的想法，有人承认偷拿，有人感到疲惫，也有人提出解决方案，如在果子上写名字以明确归属。
[P19] 马特人们经过讨论，最终通过了一项新规则：禁止偷拿别人的宝石果，违者需赔偿十个果子。
[P20] 华尔马特在搬运宝石果时不小心绊倒，导致果子摔碎，他感到非常心疼。
[P21] 一个蓝色的马特人发现树下有两个亮晶晶的宝石果，显得十分惊喜。
[P22] 画面中，一个蓝色的马特人提着装满宝石果的篮子，表情惊慌，似乎正被一个黄色的马特人发现并抓住，下方文字说明‘这次，他又被抓住了！’，暗示偷果行为再次被当场抓获。
[P23] 华尔马特被抓住偷宝石果后仍抵赖，但众人发现果子上写着“大嘴”，证明果子归属他人。
[P24] 华尔马特因偷拿宝石果被发现，按照新规则赔偿了大嘴马特二十个果子，内心感到非常后悔。
[P25] 画面中，一个黄色的马特人悠闲地躺在吊床上，旁边放着水果和饮料，树下有几颗宝石果，下方文字说明从此没人再乱拿别人的宝石果，暗示偷果问题已解决。
[P26] 马特人因偷果问题得到解决，终于可以安心地走更远的路，画面中一个黄色马特人提着篮子走在小路上。
[P27] 画面中，一个红色的马特人藏在树林的灌木丛中，下方文字说明他要去采更多的宝石果，暗示偷果行为可能再次发生。
[P28] 本页为绘本的版权及出版信息页，包含图书在版编目（CIP）数据、出版发行信息、编辑人员名单及版权声明。右侧插图描绘了一个红色马特人提着装满宝石果的篮子，站在一棵结满红色果实的树旁，树上有一个绿色的果子，地面有表示脚步的线条。
